notes: A collect-process-earn-upgrade loop with prestige, pets and unlocking areas is Simulation and specifically the Incremental Simulator preset; nothing else in the prompt is a second genre. This is the extraction hybrid the genre notes describe, so I swapped the preset's world-open for plot-isolated and added resource-shared: each player owns their own factory plot, but the answers make the collecting ground shared across every world area, and building that field as somebody's plot would break the loop. collectible-nodes are the apples, rocks and diamonds spawning on that field, physics-rig is the crusher, cutter and melter line whose bouncing, rolling, breaking reactions are the entire selling point, gate-progression the eight areas unlocking in order, and trigger-rebirth the RESTART pad. The answers settle the P4 question in favour of one continuous world, so the eight themed areas are zones on one surface and the whole build stays on P0; I also decided without a user that the server-wide events are timed dressing over the shared field rather than hazard zones, since none of them actually kills anyone.
